interpretation: Across the five already-exposed component-resolved penguin trajectories, exact-zero breeding-component loss is followed by very little observed reoccupation.
No completed reoccupation occurs within 2, 3, 5, or 10 years among loss spells with the relevant follow-up.
The only completed reoccupation occurs 16 years after loss and at a substantially lower surrounding-population state than at loss, so it does not support the generated H>0 threshold prediction.
The screen therefore motivates an independent occupancy/recovery dataset rather than a rescued threshold analysis on Palmer/Signy.
boundary: No low-count pseudo-absence threshold may be introduced.
No formal p-value is attached to the reoccupation fraction.
No causal social-attraction, dispersal, or hysteresis mechanism is identified.
This result does not modify or delay the submission manuscript.
